excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]那群粗心的傻瓜企图玩弄超越他们理解的力量，结果在[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]恒星系释放了一个强大而报复性的虚境化身！
excerpt.en: The careless fools of the [From.GetName] have meddled with forces beyond their understanding, unleashing a powerful and vengeful Shroud Avatar in the [shroud_spawn_system.GetName] system!
